dct_description_sm: The project called Dynamic Inuit Social Strategies in Changing Environments: A Long-Term Perspective has for objective to study of the Thule settlement patterns and seasonal procurement strategies in coastal Nunavik. The Nunavik, consisting of Inuit land in northern Qubec, holds a central place in the culture history of the eastern Arctic, however this region has seen only limited archaeology relating to the Inuit period, from Thule to historic times. This project will redress this situation through two intensive field seasons intended to explore linkages between climate change and Inuit society in coastal regions of Nunavik.
